reproduction_scope.fit_population_adaptation: One shared unconditional native representation per fold/seed, fit over every allowed source perturbation; native inference remains single-target. Original public cell-line example fits IFNGR2 alone.
reproduction_scope.query_control_use: Inference input only; not gradient fitting
reproduction_scope.preprocessed_cell_budget: All fixed benchmark cached rows, up to 256 observed cells per condition; this is not all cells in original h5ad.

optimization.epoch: All authorized cached training cells exactly once, one uniform shuffle. A final singleton is repartitioned as 31+2.
optimization.cell_internal_split: No added cell holdout; benchmark condition-held/external prediction validation replaces original reconstruction holdout.

validation.selection_checkpoint: Strictly smallest score; exact ties earliest; separate significant-improvement patience clock.

convergence.at_extended_cap_without_plateau: needs_decision; do not read test labels

inference.source_conditions: Same target in all other active-fold training environments, using separate inference-only source capability, including frozen internal held conditions
inference.target_controls: Independent deterministic bootstrap of legal target E to 512 query cells
inference.output: 512 complete native signed cells, 5979 genes; no clipping, Gaussian adapter, repeated mean, or external predictor
inference.mean: Exact column mean of the emitted 512-cell cloud; no replacement or output correction

evaluation.target_gene_exclusion: Frozen response metric definitions; PDS excludes all candidate-panel target genes. Distribution metrics retain all5979genes.
evaluation.native_signed_schema_exception: comparison_native_signed_cloud_v1; signed outputs permitted by distance mathematics, explicitly recorded
evaluation.test_label_boundary: Every final prediction file and checkpoint sealed before any query P read
evaluation.geometry: Only three training E; same frozen modern comparison geometry rules; no query P or held E fits
evaluation.MMD: Unbiased full-gene Gaussian U-statistic; three deterministic subsamples<=128, three bandwidths; negative values retained

statistics.overall_mean: Equal five folds after averaging three optimization seeds within each fold
statistics.between_fold_variance: Sample variance ddof=1 of five fold means
statistics.seed_variance: Sample variance ddof=1 within each fixed fold, reported separately
